summary: vanexa-agent ships bytecode-obfuscated agent that connects to a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay and executes commands on the installer's host
details: The package installs a CLI (bin/vanexa-agent.js) that loads dist/bundle.jsc, a V8-bytecode-compiled bundle produced by scripts/build_bytecode.js (esbuild minify + bytenode.compileFile). The compiled bundle hardcodes the WebSocket relay https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and contains child_process.spawn / execSync sinks reachable from that WebSocket path, so a remote party at that endpoint can drive command execution on the machine running the agent. The README depicts a LAN-only phone<->computer WebSocket topology, but the hardcoded relay is a WAN Cloudflare Workers subdomain under the handle 'hanazaki542', which does not match the declared publisher (Ikbal Fadilah / @ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01). The bytecode-only distribution hides the runtime code path — including the remote-relay + shell-exec channel — from ordinary source review; bundle.cjs is retained as a 2 MB minified fallback.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
